blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The easterlies will bring cloudy skies, scattered rain showers and thunderstorms over Caraga and the Davao region on Monday, the state weather bureau said Sunday. The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the weather system, which consists of warm winds coming from the Pacific Ocean, would continue to affect the eastern part of Mindanao in the coming days. Weather specialist Daniel James Villamil said rains could also reach the eastern part of the Visayas by the middle of the week.
